meta_description: China factory OEM brass machining parts made of brass alloy 360 through precision milling/turning services.
monitored_text: OEM CNC Milling/Turning 360 Brass Parts & Components China OEM Brass machining parts made of brass alloy 360, which is known as a free cutting copper-zinc-lead alloy that has the highest machinability among all copper alloys. The 360 brass properties are similar to steel, it has high density, high strength, and corrosion resistance, not easy to rust in air, ideal for precision machining and applicable for heavy industrial products. Our quality custom CNC milling/turning 360 brass components are primarily used in the semiconductor industry. As a seasoned brass parts manufacturer, CNClathing.com is proficient at brass/copper/bronze CNC manufacturing and fabricating best brass parts with excellent surface finish, exceptional durability, and proper dimensional accuracy at the lowest cost, as well as reliable CNC machining for semiconductor fields.
